newsitem.title: USA: Hemagen to buy Cellular Products.
newsitem.headline: Hemagen to buy Cellular Products.

text.p: Hemagen Diagnostics Inc said on Tuesday that it has agreed to acquire substantially all of the assets of Cellular Products Inc of Buffalo, N.Y., for undisclosed terms.
Hemagen said it could save considerable costs over time by making viral materials in Cellular facilities.
Cellular makes biotechnology materials, research assays and clinical diagnostic test kits, with a focus on infectious diseases, particularly HIV and HTLV.

Cellular Products has been operating under Chapter 11 bankruptcy since November 1994, but Hemagen said unaudited financial statements indicate the company returned to profitability and positive cash flow in each of the two most recent quarters. Revenues are close to a $1.8 million annual rate, Hemagen said.
Hemagen said it would not make cuts in the Cellular Products organization. It said the acquisition awaits confirmation of Cellular Product's financial status by Hemagen's independent auditors.
